notes: Everything that has been waiting since 18 August, not just a hotfix. Community reference laps are now open to everyone: the fastest clean lap on a track coaches the rest of us, corner by corner, in your own language, with no beta key needed. A new Lap History page: pick a track, then a car, then a lap, and you get your real racing line, speed, gear and pedals, how much time you lose in each corner, and clicking a corner compares your line with your best lap (the line needs car position from the sim, which iRacing does not send). Practice now coaches you: a corner tip after every clean lap, the question how can I be faster is answered with a corner instead of repair the car, no more pit now fuel is low on a full tank, and no overtaking talk outside a race. Long races are fixed: LMU and rF2 were feeding the race clock in the wrong unit, so six-hour races talked nonsense, and the new strategy engine picks the number of stops by what is actually fastest rather than by tank size. The free Edge voice was dying on a TLS handshake for many of you: fixed, plus a male or female choice, better Dutch and Polish voices, and 359 UI texts that silently fell back to English are now translated. New look: reworked sidebar and five UI styles you can switch live in Settings. One ask: leave data sharing on and drive clean laps, because the coaching pool is still empty. Most of this was verified by reading the code and in demo mode rather than on track, so if the engineer says something odd out there, please use the feedback form in the app.
